card.title: HUMBER Mk II
card.flavorText: The Humber Mk II was a British armored reconnaissance car, used by the British and their Allies in WWII. It had a crew of 3 (driver, gunner, commander), a main armament of Mk I-III 15 mm Besa machine gun and a secondary armament of 7.92 mm Besa machine gun.
